limitations: Fresh-panel results are retrospective and do not establish prospective guarantees.
The underlying is an ex-post truth proxy, not a current Evidence State voter.
P1a assimilates xStock; xStock-versus-P1a is model-based challenger evidence, not independent-market proof.
X-Perp corroboration is directional only and has no fitted Gaussian residual threshold.
Within the SUPPORT band X-Perp direction is descriptive; exact-time source availability and data quality are required.

support.rationale: James's frozen SUPPORT band defines NVDAx's low-disagreement regime. A healthy exact-time X-Perp observation is required for tri-source readiness; its direction within SUPPORT is descriptive only because no separate directional threshold is research-validated.

challenge.rationale: The retrospective fresh tri-source rule is a conservative escalation: 60 candidates, 6 with contemporaneous truth, yielded 5 TP and 1 FP (83.3% precision), while recovering 5/29 tail events (17.2% recall). Enable CHALLENGED as a high-selectivity, low-recall risk signal; do not interpret it as exhaustive tail detection.
